g.text: Base profile: private-only gateway and model connectivity
private-only end state after staging, not runtime proof. PaaS services stay outside the VNet; private endpoints are inside.
CUSTOMER VIRTUAL NETWORK / 10.247.0.0/16 in the example profile
NO PUBLIC INGRESS / PRIVATE ROUTE NEEDED
Needs supported private routing and DNS; a
valid key or token is not enough.
Private endpoint is the ingress path.
Outbound VNet integration reaches the private
endpoint, not a public model route.
Checks private DNS, routing and model
Use an existing client instead if
Lets private clients reach the gateway.
Connects this VNet to the model
Gives the gateway a path into this
PRIVATE DNS ZONES / LINKED TO THIS VNET
Resolve gateway and model hostnames to private endpoint IPs. Custom DNS clients need an appropriate forwarding path.
Hybrid alternative: private-connectivity keeps gateway public ingress. Neither profile configures private hosted-agent execution.
